checks.name: unsafe endpoints are rejected before a socket is created
changed domain, endpoint, transport or SASL policy fails before connection
backpressure removes the IQ callback and never enters the sent-stanza queue
queued inbound events are bounded and overflow terminates without late callbacks
actual nbxmpp performs SCRAM authentication, stream restart, binding and IQ reply over WSS
graceful close and reconnect use a fresh socket and working upstream state machine
destroying an active client disposes socket, proxy and queued callbacks
missing negotiated xmpp protocol never reaches authentication
malformed XML terminates the stream before authentication
external entity XML is rejected by the real parser
binary input is rejected at the socket boundary
oversized input is rejected before Python parsing
stream header from another domain is rejected
authentication failure does not become a connected session
wrong SCRAM server signature fails authentication
interrupted authentication produces a terminal outcome
stalled authentication is terminated by the negotiation deadline
protocol/authentication logs stay empty and no nbxmpp timers remain

scope: Real WebSocket plus upstream nbxmpp against a scripted synthetic peer; no 5july or contact messaging
environment: Actual browser module worker and native WebSocket; upstream nbxmpp in WebAssembly; same-origin synthetic peer
